notes.title: Build 0.10.14
notes.content:
* Hot fix for incorrect ARcoin balance 
* New dice roller! New dialog box displays each die result with the ability to re-roll or remove individual dies. 
* New assets and easier content updates 
* Performance improvements with reduced CPU and GPU utilization. Less heat and fans!
* Much improved loading speed 
* Enhanced contrast and saturation makes assets pop!
* Bug fixes and stability improvements
